blocks.en: Explores how climate change and environmental conditions can place plants under stress, from extreme heat and drought to diseases and other biological threats. Through hands-on activities, experiments, and interactive games, students learn how plants respond to stress and how synthetic biology can be used to understand and develop new approaches for protecting crops.
